actions.name: elemental restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into dirt, and it gains a new body in [[/r 1d4#Days]] days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: wishes
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has a [[/r 1d100cs<31#Knows Wish on 1]]{30 percent} chance of knowing the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can understand. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts the spell for the creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has cast it three times, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three attacks, using [[/item .mmStormBlade0000]] or [[/item .mmStormBolt00000]] in any combination.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectEvil]{Detect Evil and Good}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic} 2/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCreateFood]{Create Food and Water} (can create wine instead of water), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplTongues000]{Tongues}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWindWalk00]{Wind Walk} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCreation00]{Creation}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGaseousFor]{Gaseous Form}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMajorImage]{Major Image}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPlaneShift]{Plane Shift}

actions.name: create whirlwind
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=TYNKL0QDItFpbR2G]]-foot-radius, [[lookup @target.template.height activity=TYNKL0QDItFpbR2G]]-foot-high [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=TYNKL0QDItFpbR2G]] centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Concentration on it ends. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=TYNKL0QDItFpbR2G]] (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected). Failure: While in the whirlwind, the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes [[/damage average]] damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: storm bolt
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.
